title: Dimasalang Bridge to reopen on Oct. 20 ahead of Undas: DPWH
summary: The northbound portion of the Dimasalang Bridge in Sampaloc, Manila is expected to reopen by Oct. 20, the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) said Wednesday.
